svg.title: whoami: Suriyaprakash Palanisamy in numbers
svg.desc: A tmux session on a green CRT. Left pane: whoami --json prints name Suriyaprakash Palanisamy, title Senior Software Engineer, now on an ML forecasting platform at Freddie Mac in McLean VA building FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS, 10+ years across the full SDLC, five domains (finance, healthcare, retail, pharma, insurance), led backend teams and API development, AI-driven development. Right pane: 10+ years, 50+ AWS microservices platform built and supported, 5 industries, over 85% PyTest coverage on new code, 3000 to 1000 line refactor with 20% faster performance.
